## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      4 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Aug 19, 2026 - Aug 24, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _C N_, Aug 24, 2026, 1/5: "i signed up for a trial month, then realized that you put people on automatic subscription and quadruple the monthly cost after first month. i called immediately to cancel. but i just saw on my bank statement that you charged me $44.66 for this month! this has to be illegal!! cancel this immediately and refund my account. i am reporting to my bank! Follow up: THESE PEOPLE ARE CRIMINALS, DO NOT SIGN UP EVER!!! REFUSE TO PROVIDE REFUND FOR FRAUDULENT CHARGES!"
            2. _B “Ilovetacos” R_, Aug 21, 2026, 4/5: "The app itself is great. It is just too expensive for my budget. When I did have a problem figuring part of it out, Kate Brown in the support area was quick to respond, had everything I needed all in one conversation. No need for multiple back and forths. Overall it's a great app and the workouts are easy to follow, well explained and adaptable."
            3. _Karen Rosenberg_, Aug 21, 2026, 5/5: "Although this program is expensive, it does help get you moving. However, because of the expense I will not be renewing my subscription. Sorry."
<!--/ir-theme-->
